newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains stifled by stg uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains stifled by stg uncertainty.

text.p: LIFFE grains and the UK physical grains market were both subdued as currency uncertainty kept many market players sitting on their hands, traders said.
An easier sterling against other European currencies helped LIFFE wheat to end higher, after an afternoon of minimal activity.
But the final total of 160 lots remained dismal compared with the contract's recent record, as many players held nervously back.
July was the most active month on wheat, with 72 lots done. It last changed hands 0.50 stg higher at 77.90 stg.
Barley also rose, on a total day's trade of nine lots, all on November which went 0.30 stg higher to 80.00 stg.

Physical markets were also stifled by currency uncertainty, traders said. Feed wheat was reported done for delivery to Norfolk in July at 83.00 stg. On Wednesday, July delivery to Norfolk/Suffolk was done at 84.00 stg.
